summary: Tested the VoxCPM2 integration (Colab/Modal setup scripts, voxcpm-check, the https rule in settings, fallback with vox_error, AI Settings UI). All 4 scripts are served with status 200 and compile. The fake-model contract test (scripts/fake_voxcpm_test.py) passed every case: Khmer goes to voxcpm2 with reference_wav_path, prompt_wav_path and prompt_text passed and emoji removed; English goes to openai; a wrong key falls back to microsoft with 'Wrong API key'; a server that is down falls back to microsoft with 'Cannot reach the server'; an incoming Khmer voice message is answered with voxcpm2. The generate() argument names match the official VoxCPM2 docs (checked with a web search). All 11 new pytest tests pass. All UI checks pass: both guide cards and their one-liners use window.location.origin, copy sets the clipboard and shows a 'Copied' toast, the check button is disabled when empty and shows a red error for an unreachable URL, and a bogus saved URL gives engine Microsoft plus the amber vox-error text. At 390px there is no horizontal overflow. The real model on a GPU was not tested.

minor.issue: The server will fetch any https URL a logged-in user enters (a small SSRF risk; it only does GET /health with a 30s timeout). Consider blocking private/internal IP addresses.

issues: The intro text still says 'vllm serve openbmb/VoxCPM2 --omni'. The app now uses its own /v1/audio/speech contract with ref_audio and ref_text, which a vLLM server may not accept. Consider removing that wording or noting that it is not supported.
Test Khmer voice / Test seller voice use the SAVED settings. The label 'save first' only says this on the seller-voice button.

action_items: Optional: block private IPs in voxcpm-check
Optional: update the vllm wording in the VoxCPM2 intro text
critical_code_review_comments: The settings save and the check endpoint handle https differently: write_settings strips the URL and removes the trailing slash, but voxcpm_check only removes the trailing slash. A URL with spaces fails the check but saves fine. This is cosmetic.
voxcpm_tts uses a 120s timeout. Modal cold start is 30-90s, so a whole incoming-message reply may take a long time to arrive. Acceptable.
seed_data_creation: The fake test uploaded a seller voice sample for Sunrise Coffee (seller_voice_media_id 3c7eef1f...). voxcpm_url and voxcpm_key were restored to empty (checked in the DB). It also created conversation session vox-e2e-1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use Sunrise Coffee only. Run the pytest file with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. The fake contract test is scripts/fake_voxcpm_test.py (port 8099). The real VoxCPM2/Colab/Modal could not be tested.
